continuity: Gansu Murim has assembled 30,000 martial artists and arranged three defensive lines across Dunhuang, the Great Snow Mountain, and the Qilian Mountains; the Kongtong Sect is already on the front lines.
The Gansu force includes dark-path figures, and Sima Gong has pledged his life to prevent trouble; Jeok Cheongang and Zhongnan elders support accepting them because they fight for the Murim Alliance.
Sima Gong sent trusted scouts beyond the desert after ominous signs; their findings are not yet known. He expects Dark Heaven to target Gansu and proposes that Jeok Cheongang go to Qinghai.
A messenger urgently calls to the Sect Leader from outside the meeting room; the message is not yet known.
Taishan remains unusually motionless and uneating at the feast, and Namho reacted to a scent connected to a recent memory.
plot: Sima Gong reveals that Gansu has assembled thirty thousand martial artists and established three defensive lines across Dunhuang, the Great Snow Mountain, and the Qilian Mountains, with the Kongtong Sect already deployed. The force includes dark-path figures, but Sima and Jeok Cheongang affirm that they are fighting for the Murim Alliance; Sima stakes his life on keeping them in check. He says ominous signs prompted him to send scouts beyond the desert and urges Jeok to go to Qinghai, though he expects Dark Heaven to target Gansu. As the meeting considers the plan, an urgent voice calls from outside the closed doors.
translation_decisions: Keep “dark-path figures” distinct from “unorthodox faction”; render 관무불가침 as the principle of government–Murim noninterference.
